use_cases: Landing page hero section with interactive image grid showcase
Product or service introduction sections for websites
Course or class selection landing pages with visual appeal
Portfolio or media gallery entry points with shuffle animations
Interactive hero sections for creative or fitness platforms
ai_summary: A hero section component featuring a responsive two-column layout with a shuffle animation effect on an Unsplash image grid. Built with Framer Motion for smooth animations, it includes headline text, descriptive copy, and a CTA button. The images randomly rearrange using a Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm, creating an engaging visual effect suitable for landing pages and product showcases.
